lcc_original: 以挪士生該南之後，又活了八百一十五年，這期間還生兒養女。
notes: Hebrew numeric construction has שָׁנָה (WH08141) twice — once mid-compound after 'hundreds' (百) and once at the end; LCC has only one 年, so both WH08141 tags are attached to 年.
UNV 並且生 → LCC 這期間還生: LCC adds 這期間 (a temporal phrase) with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated; 還生 receives WH03205+WTH8686.
{<WAH0853>} (direct object marker, Hebrew אֵת) has no explicit word in LCC; kept implicit with braces, placed after the morphology tag on 生 as in UNV.
